summary: Build pricing strategy for services and solutions with practical tools, margin analysis, value metrics, and pricing dashboards.
lede: Solutions pricing combines cost, customer value and market evidence to set defensible prices for services and bundled offers. For professionals handling service pricing, revenue, proposals or commercial performance, this course provides a structured way to build and defend pricing decisions. You’ll practice analyzing price waterfalls and margins, designing value metrics and tiered packages, benchmarking competitors, and governing discounts through dashboards and approval processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with service pricing, revenue, proposals, or commercial performance and need a more structured way to set and defend price.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and, if available, access to Power BI for dashboard work. Participants should arrive with one real service, advisory, managed solution, or recurring offer, plus any current pricing sheets, discount rules, or competitor examples they can safely share for workshop use.
